items.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ, وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ, وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ, وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ. وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ الْمُهَنَّأُ فَيَقُولُ: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ, وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً, وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ, وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ
items.title: Congratulation on the occasion of a birth
items.translation: May Allah bless you with His gift to you, and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness.(1)The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: "May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly".(2)

items.arabic: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ, إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
items.title: When insulted while fasting
items.translation: I am fasting. I am fasting.

items.arabic: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ, وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ, فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرحَمُكَ اللَّهُ, فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
items.title: Upon sneezing
items.translation: When you sneeze, then say: "All praises and thanks are to Allah".(1)Your companion should say: "May Allah have mercy upon you".(2)Then you should replies: "May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order".(3)

items.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
items.title: When a misbeliever praise Allah after sneezing
items.translation: May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.

items.arabic: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً, أَوْ إِذَا اشْتَرَى خَادِماً فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا, وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ, وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا, وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ, وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيراً فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
items.title: On the wedding night or when buying an animal
items.translation: When any of you marries a woman or purchases a maid-servant then let him say: "O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of her and the goodness upon which You have created her, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of her and from the evil upon which You have created her". If you purchase a camel (animal) then take hold of the top of its hump and say the same.

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
items.title: When angry
items.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ, وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً
items.title: Upon seeing someone in trial or tribulation
items.translation: Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created.

items.arabic: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما قَاَلَ: كَانَ يُعَدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الوَاحِدِ مِائَةُ مَرَّةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَقُومَ: (رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي, وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ, إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ
items.title: At a sitting or gathering
items.translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance, You are the Ever-Relenting, the All-Forgiving.

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ, أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ, أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
items.reference: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, At-Tirmizi and An-Nasa'i, Ahmad 6/77
items.title: For the expiation of sins, said at the conclusion of a sitting or gathering
items.translation: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise is to You. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.(Allah's Messenger (SAW) did not sit in a gathering, and did not recite the Qur'an, and did not perform any prayer without concluding by saying this invocation.)

items.arabic: وَلَكَ
items.title: Returning a supplication of forgiveness
items.translation: And you.

items.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً
items.title: To one who does you a favour
items.translation: May Allah reward you with good.

items.arabic: أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ
items.title: To one who pronounces his love for you, for Allah’s sake
items.translation: May He for Whose sake you love me, love you.

items.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
items.title: To one who has offered you some of his wealth
items.translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your property.

items.arabic: بارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ, إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ
items.title: To the debtor when his debt is settled
items.translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth, surely the reward for a loan is praise and returning (what was borrowed).

items.arabic: وَفِيكَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ
items.title: Returning a supplication after having bestowed a gift or charity upon someone
items.translation: And may Allah bless you.

items.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لاَ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا, وَلاَ تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا, أَوَلاَ أَدُلُّكُم عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُم, أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ
items.title: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting
items.translation: You shall not enter Paradise until you believe, and you have not believed until you love one another. Shall I tell you of something you can do to make you love one another? Spread the greetings of Salam (peace) amongst yourselves.

items.arabic: ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ جَمَعَهُنَّ فَقَدْ جَمَعَ الْإِيمَانَ: الْإِنْصَافُ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ, وَبَذْلُ السَّلاَمِ لِلْعَالَمِ, وَالْإِنْفَاقُ مِنَ الإِقْتَارِ
items.title: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting
items.translation: There are Three things which whoever gathers all of them together, then he has gathered Iman (Faith): justice with oneself, greeting people with greetings of Salam (peace), and freeing oneself from stinginess.

items.arabic: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أيُّ الْإِسْلاَمِ خَيْرٌ قَالَ: تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ, وَتَقْرأُ السَّلاَمَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ
items.title: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting
items.translation: A man asked the Prophet (SAW), What is the best act of Islam? He said, To feed others and to give greetings of Salam (peace) to those whom you know and to those whom you do not know.

items.arabic: إذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: وَعَلَيْكُمْ
items.title: Returning a greeting to a misbeliever
items.translation: If one of the Christians and Jews (People of the Scripture) greets you saying As-Salaamu 'alaykum, then say (to him): And upon you.

items.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
items.title: For one you have insulted
items.translation: O Allah, whomever of the believers I have abused, give him the reward of a sacrificial slaughter for it on the Day of Resurrection.

items.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُم مَادِحاً صَاحِبَهُ لاَ مَحَالَةَ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ, وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَداً, أَحْسِبُهُ – إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ – كَذَا وَكَذَا
items.title: The etiquette of praising a fellow Muslim
items.translation: The Prophet (SAW) said: "If any of you praises his companion then let him say: "I deem so-and-so (person's name) to be... And Allah is his Assessor and I don't praise anyone, putting it forward, in front of Allah's commendation, however I assume him so and so ...if he knows that of him".

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ, وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ, [وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْراً مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ]
items.title: For the one that have been praised
items.translation: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of and make me better than they imagine.
